title: Farm Impact Alerts
warning_distinction_note: Official weather warnings indicate regional meteorological hazard levels, whereas CropClimate AI calculates farm-specific crop vulnerability based on soil, crop stage, and drainage.

factors.MODERATE_DRAINAGE: Moderate drainage slows water discharge during heavy showers.
factors.GOOD_DRAINAGE: Good field drainage allows fast surface runoff.
factors.SENSITIVE_STAGE: Current crop growth stage is sensitive to excess root moisture.
factors.HIGH_RAINFALL: Heavy forecast precipitation exceeds soil infiltration rate.
factors.SATURATED_SOIL: Soil moisture is elevated from antecedent rainfall.
factors.PROLONGED_SUBMERSION: Prolonged waterlogging restricts root zone oxygen exchange.
factors.CLAY_SOIL_RETENTION: High clay fraction slows water percolation.
factors.TOP_DRESSING_VULNERABLE: Recent fertilizer application risks nutrient leaching.
